primaryWitnesses.text: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear the LORD, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

wikipediaArticleRead.supportJa: 見出しと導入は族長ヤコブを扱い、同じ記事の導入にIsraelの別名と改名が記載される。プロフィールの別名表示・記事リンクは2KI17:34にゲート。

identityAssessmentJa: 2KI13:23はJacob本人をアブラハムとイサクに並ぶ契約の祖先として名指す。2KI17:34は同じ人物の子らと改名を明示する。Wikipedia本文はこのJacob/Israelの関係を扱うが、後の別名を初出に持ち込まない。
